reason: Both cast Sleight of Hand and play a land if it finds one; B only names the Island it found, so the two lines are the same.
After Day of Judgment, A keeps No More Lies mana up through the opponent's turn and casts Consult at instant speed, while a second Tablet adds little with 8 lands already out.

Casting Harmonizer and Ascension before combat lets the land drops (Fabled Passage, its fetch, Escape Tunnel's unblockable) double an attacker's power; B casts them after combat and wastes every landfall pump, and the opponent's open mana can't counter (Hamlet makes only colorless).
Both stun blockers with Cryomancer, but B also kills a Mightform Harmonizer and uses Emeritus, which matters against an explosive landfall board; A leaves mana idle for a nearly useless Spell Snare.
Emeritus is summoning sick, so casting it before combat gains nothing; A casts it and also uses its extra spell and land drop, getting more cards and mana from the same turn.
Both wipe the board (Marvel is indestructible) and keep plenty of counter mana; Machinations at their end step and Three Steps' card draw are worth about the same.

At 4 life, Duress cannot stop a haste dragon, which is the main lethal threat; harmonizing Winternight Stories uses this turn's otherwise idle 5 mana for three cards (discarding Excruciator) to find answers next turn, at the cost of a small chance that Duress takes a lethal Burst Lightning.
